purpose: Acquire a one-time frozen free historical source snapshot for the untouched V2.8.5 backward holdout with bounded API and repository cost.

snapshot_freeze.normalized_sample_snapshot: Parquet partitioned if necessary to keep each Git object below 100MB

problem_elimination.avoid: No repeated vendor polling or later re-download as a substitute for frozen bytes.
problem_elimination.absorb: Reuse V2.8.1 official PIT membership intervals and V2.8.3 factor definitions.
problem_elimination.substitute: Deterministic 20% identity-hash sample preserves a large cross-section at about one-fifth of API/storage cost.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Download once, freeze normalized Parquet and hashes, and reuse locally for every V2.8.5 calculation.
problem_elimination.optimize: Only if the bounded acquisition itself proves too slow.

forbidden: No holdout outcome inspection during source probe.
No changing sample membership due to missing/poor returns.
